intake: Source file types and approximate row/sheet counts
Rules for duplicates, blanks, dates, currencies and formulas
Required output format and whether macros/pivots must be preserved
Expected reconciliation totals and acceptance examples
acceptance: Preserve an untouched source copy
Reconcile input/output row counts and explain rejected rows
Validate duplicates, blanks, types and date/currency rules
Spot-check formulas and deterministic reruns
tools: pandas when transformation complexity justifies it
openpyxl for XLSX structure and formatting

intake: Staging URL or reproducible export and theme/plugin versions
Affected pages, viewports and expected appearance
Form destination and safe test method
Backup/rollback owner and production access boundary
acceptance: No horizontal overflow at agreed viewports
No unrelated page regressions
Form success/failure path verified in staging
Accessibility and browser console/network checks recorded
tools: Playwright for browser checks when justified
Disposable WordPress environment for CMS-specific validation

intake: Exact source domains and proof of authorization where needed
Target fields, pagination and expected volume
Terms/robots and request-rate constraints
Resume/checkpoint and output schema requirements
acceptance: Source access and terms reviewed
Request rate, timeout and stop conditions bounded
Pagination, partial responses and schema drift handled
No access-control bypass or prohibited personal-data collection
tools: Python standard library HTTP clients for small bounded jobs
Scrapy only when scale and maintenance justify it
pytest or unittest for deterministic fixtures

intake: API documentation and sanitized request/response samples
Auth type, minimum scopes and credential owner
Webhook verification, event volume and retry expectations
Systems of record and idempotency key behavior
acceptance: Credentials never enter source control or logs
Timeouts and bounded retries are explicit
Idempotency and non-idempotent write behavior are tested
Webhook signature/replay protection verified where supported
tools: Python HTTP client and standard-library tests
n8n only after license and hosting model review

intake: Original files and target editable/output format
Page count, field types, calculations and signature needs
RTL/font/print requirements and target viewers
Whether pages are scanned and OCR is authorized
acceptance: Preserve source and reconcile page/field counts
Validate text, fields, tab order and print output
Inspect representative pages in target viewers
Surface OCR uncertainty as exceptions
tools: python-docx and ReportLab for document generation
Tesseract only for scanned pages with confidence review

intake: Approved source extracts and refresh requirements
Metric formulas, grain, filters and date timezone
Audience, access roles and delivery platform
Expected reconciliation totals and empty-data behavior
acceptance: Metric dictionary documents formula, grain and source
Totals reconcile to supplied source
Date boundaries, missing data and duplicates tested
Refresh/access/licensing limits disclosed
tools: Streamlit for local interactive views when appropriate
Client BI platform only with confirmed entitlement
